safety.harmful: ledger has any non-abstaining wrong answer in its 30-answer conversation bundle and comparator has none

benefit.unit: conversation correct-fraction difference over all 30 planned answers

missingData: Never drop planned slots. A missing, invalid, duplicate or unknown unit/probe/arm/repeat prevents acceptance. Incomplete scopes have no inferential estimates (not complete-case estimates), remain inconclusive, and ledger accuracy uses the planned denominator with missing/invalid answers incorrect. Hard failures established by complete scopes or audit remain failures. Native-arm coverage is required as well. Missing audit material prevents acceptance.
decision: Intersection-union: pass only if all gates pass with complete integrity and audit. Hard rate/floor/audit failure or a one-sided confidence bound establishing failure gives fail. Otherwise give inconclusive, with reasons; no outcome-dependent extension. Statistical bounds are per conversation, never independent probes.
